corrections.title: Declarations in news: states, heritage and international
corrections.rocket: Gujarat / Mumbai Port — Jawahar Dweep declared plastic-free — 2 October 2026; first plastic-free marine oil terminal in India
corrections.corrected: Maharashtra / Mumbai Port: Jawahar Dweep declared plastic-free; 2 October 2026; first plastic-free marine oil terminal in India.
corrections.checked: Jawahar Dweep (Butcher Island) lies about 4 km off Mumbai's coast and was declared plastic-free by Mumbai Port Authority on 2 Oct 2026; it is in Maharashtra, not Gujarat. The Week (https://www.theweek.in/news/maritime/2026/10/02/mumbai-port-s-gandhi-jayanti-milestone-jawahar-dweep-becomes-india-s-first-plastic-free-oil-terminal.html)

corrections.rocket: Quad joint declarations — 52nd G7 Summit-related engagements — 15–17 June 2026, Évian-les-Bains, France — Joint declarations addressed public health and technology, migration and crime, and economy and supply chains.
corrections.corrected: Quad joint declarations: 52nd G7 Summit-related engagements; 15–17 June 2026, Évian-les-Bains, France; joint declarations addressed public health and technology, migration and crime, and economy and supply chains.
corrections.checked: The Evian G7 summit (15–17 June 2026) adopted nine leaders' declarations on those themes (https://www.elysee.fr/en/G7evian/2026/06/17/the-outcomes-of-the-evian-g7-summit), but the search found nothing calling them 'Quad' declarations; the label could not be confirmed or replaced, so Rocket's line is kept.

corrections.title: Declarations in news: states, heritage and international
corrections.rocket: Lebanon was the first Arab country to formally abolish the death penalty.
corrections.corrected: Lebanon was the first Arab country to formally abolish the death penalty.
corrections.checked: The 11 Aug 2026 vote is widely reported as the first in the Arab world (https://newsonair.gov.in/lebanon-becomes-first-arab-country-to-abolish-death-penalty/), though the Death Penalty Information Center counts Lebanon second in the Arab League after Djibouti (https://deathpenaltyinfo.org/lebanon-parliament-abolishes-death-penalty-after-22-year-long-unofficial-moratorium); the prevailing description is kept.
